subtitle: Bureau of bounties and voluntary declarations.
markUnpayable: Holy Office mark. Can't be paid off, must be served.
notEnoughMoney: Not enough money for that fine.
declarationBlurb: Confess an unrecorded crime for half the fine. It still goes on your record and raises your bounty until paid or served.
custodyBlurb: Outstanding bounty: {bounty}. Both options below close this terminal.
surrenderBlurb: Go to the cells. Time served lowers your bounty; you're released at zero. No hearing.
hearingBlurb: Your case goes before Eris. An acquittal clears the record; a conviction does not.
alreadyInCustody: You are already in custody. The Bureau appreciates the enthusiasm.
surrenderConfirmBody: You'll be held in the cells until your {bounty} bounty is worked off.
hearingConfirmBody: Your case ({bounty} outstanding) goes before Eris. Her verdict stands.
hearingConfirmClean: You have no charges outstanding. Eris will still see you, and she will have opinions about that.

record.heading: Case File: {name}
record.blurb: Your charges and their fines. Settling one pays it and clears it.
